targets.query:
from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "application_performance")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "baseline_latency_ms" or r._field == "optimized_latency_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "application_performance")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "baseline_loss_pct" or r._field == "optimized_loss_pct")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "application_performance" and r._field == "bandwidth_bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["application"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "sum")

from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "application_performance")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "baseline_latency_ms" or r._field == "optimized_latency_ms")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "application"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r.baseline_latency_ms == 0.0 then 0.0 else (r.baseline_latency_ms - r.optimized_latency_ms) / r.baseline_latency_ms * 100.0, _field: "latency_improvement_pct"}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "endpoint_telemetry" and r._field == "vpn_connected")
  |> group(columns: ["device_id", "vpn_provider"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "vpn_state")

from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "endpoint_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency_ms" or r._field == "jitter_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["device_id", "network_type", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "application_experience")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "baseline_value" or r._field == "optimized_value" or r._field == "target_value")
  |> group(columns: ["application", "slo", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "application_experience" and r._field == "avoided_incident")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 1 else 0}))
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "avoided_incidents")

from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "route_decision" and r._field == "score")
  |> group(columns: ["application", "candidate_path"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "candidate_score")
